CreateRemoteThread.description: Creates a thread that executes in another process's memory space (used for DLL or shellcode injection).

WriteProcessMemory.description: Writes data or executable code directly into the target process's memory.

VirtualAllocEx.description: Allocates memory in another process's address space.

QueueUserAPC.description: Queues an APC function on a thread so that malicious code can execute (Early Bird Injection or APC Injection).

SetThreadContext.description: Overwrites the target thread's register context (EIP/RIP), as used in Process Hollowing.

NtUnmapViewOfSection.description: Unmaps the original process memory image to prepare for process hollowing.

RtlCreateUserThread.description: An undocumented native API used to create a remote thread and potentially bypass EDR monitoring.

VirtualAlloc.description: Allocates a new memory region, often requesting PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE permissions to hold shellcode.

VirtualProtect.description: Changes memory-protection permissions, for example from RW to RWX so injected code can execute.

VirtualProtectEx.description: Changes the memory-protection permissions of a remote process.

ReadProcessMemory.description: Reads data from another process's memory, often to dump passwords or LSASS memory.

LoadLibraryA.description: Loads a dynamic-link library (DLL) into a running process's address space.

LoadLibraryW.description: Loads a Unicode DLL while the process is running.

GetProcAddress.description: Dynamically retrieves an exported function's address to conceal the import table from static analysis.

LdrLoadDll.description: A low-level NTDLL native API for loading DLLs that may be used to evade monitoring hooks.

RegSetValueExA.description: Writes or modifies a Registry value, often to create a Run key for automatic startup with Windows.

RegCreateKeyExA.description: Creates a new configuration key in the Windows Registry.

RegCreateKeyExW.description: Creates a new Unicode Registry key.

URLDownloadToFileA.description: Downloads a binary file or payload from the Internet to local disk.

URLDownloadToFileW.description: Downloads a file from a Unicode URL.

InternetOpenUrlA.description: Opens a connection to a remote URL to send a beacon or receive C2 commands.

HttpSendRequestA.description: Sends an HTTP request to a command-and-control (C2) server.

WSAStartup.description: Initializes the Winsock library to establish TCP or UDP network socket connections.

IsDebuggerPresent.description: Checks whether the process is being monitored by an attached debugger.

CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent.description: Checks for a remote debugger through the kernel debug port.

NtQueryInformationProcess.description: Queries low-level process information, often reading ProcessDebugPort to detect a debugger.

SetWindowsHookExA.description: Installs a hook in the system message-processing chain to monitor keyboard or mouse input (keylogging).

GetAsyncKeyState.description: Determines the state of recently pressed keys to collect passwords or user information.

CreateProcessA.description: Creates and runs a new process in the operating system.

WinExec.description: A legacy function that runs a command-line application or child executable.

ShellExecuteA.description: Opens or executes a file, script, or URL through the Windows shell.
